policy: Explicit deployment input ownership requested by the repository owner; matches are configuration policy violations, not proof of runtime faults.

private_corpora.provenance: Immutable Git-object exports and selected-file SHA-256 digests retained outside Git; no private source or identifying pins published.

inspection: All 124 added attribute locations inspected, with resource and local-alias contexts checked across affected schema categories. No known inspected false positives under the explicit input-ownership policy. The 34 public additions are examples using literal resource arguments; caller module arguments remain valid.
measurement: Native run_isolated_corpora, alternating baseline/candidate order, three fresh-process rounds, batches <=250 files, same pinned environment. First round has uncontrolled OS cache state; later rounds are disk-cache-warm, not persistent-process warm. macOS maximum process RSS, shared machine; no tail-latency or memory-bound claim.
limits: Curated provider scope and network/DNS/address schema fields, not all strings or resource names.
Cross-file aliases, object traversals, unknown expressions and most mixed templates remain opaque.
Only authored .tf files; no Terraform JSON, generated code or fixtures.
Valid input boundaries: typed defaults, tfvars and caller module arguments; protocol constants and provider global placement selectors retained.
recommendation: Retain existing ERROR for the explicit input policy; no autofix. Publish before consumer adoption; do not accept baseline debt.
